description: Accurate Canadian statutory holiday calendars for all 13 provinces/territories plus federal jurisdiction (2026–2027), with weekend-observance shifting and business-day arithmetic. Answers: is this date a holiday? what are the holidays this year? add N business days; next business day. Built from official federal and provincial employment-standards sources — beyond what an LLM knows natively, with jurisdiction differences (Family Day, Louis Riel Day, Islander Day, Heritage Day, St-Jean-Baptiste, Truth and Reconciliation, Remembrance Day, Boxing Day, Discovery Day, Nunavut Day) encoded and sourced.
title: Canadian Statutory Holidays & Business Days
